trade.hv_voltage.precedent: X-57 hit interference between its inverters and onboard systems and redesigned its battery for overheating; integration problems and component shortages ended the programme before first flight.
sources: NASA: X-57 project creates paths toward electric aviation

trade.tilt_load_path.label: Tilt mechanism: spindle station, bearings and fitting concept
trade.tilt_load_path.note: Sets whirl flutter, jump take-off root strain and nacelle CG against the elastic axis
trade.tilt_load_path.precedent: V-22 tilts the whole nacelle: engine, gearbox and rotor. V-280 keeps the engines fixed and tilts only the proprotor gearbox; Bell cites maintenance (engine, shaft and gearbox removable independently) and says the V-280 weighs less than a V-22. Halo already keeps the turbines in the fuselage and tilts only motors, gearbox and rotor, the V-280 logic carried further.
sources: The War Zone: V-280 against V-22, with Bell's head of tiltrotor systems

trade.failure_architecture.label: Failure architecture: interconnect shaft or electrical cross-strapping

trade.failure_architecture.precedent: XV-15 and V-22 both carry a cross-shaft so one engine drives both rotors; V-280 kept it. No tiltrotor that has flown has replaced the shaft with electrical cross-strapping, so Halo's choice carries certification risk as well as mass.
sources: The War Zone: V-280 against V-22, with Bell's head of tiltrotor systems

Joby JAS4-2: the NTSB named the tilt actuator linkage at one station, which let blades run steeper than commanded, as a contributing factor in a cascading prototype loss.

trade.fuselage_material.label: Fuselage structure: material and construction
trade.fuselage_material.precedent: V-22: empty weight ran 1,520 kg over specification by the end of full-scale development, partly from over-ambitious new materials. Composite frames needing many parts and fasteners were replaced by machined aluminium (32.4 lb against 26.4 lb per frame, 39 parts against 1, 258 fasteners against none); composite share fell from 57 % to 43 % of the airframe.
sources: Flight International, 'Tilting in favour' (2000), as reported

trade.rotor_construction.note: Blade stiffness sets the rotor frequencies

trade.hover_cases.label: Hover cases: hot and high (4,000 ft, 95 F) and engine-out duration

trade.weight_margin.label: Weight margin policy: confidence level and management reserve
trade.weight_margin.note: 99 % today; sets the NTE take-off weight
trade.weight_margin.precedent: V-22: 1,520 kg empty-weight overrun in full-scale development; the next phase gave each integrated product team a weight allocation to hold or trade, the discipline this ledger encodes.
sources: Flight International, 'Tilting in favour' (2000), as reported

trade.load_factors.label: Design loads: ultimate and jump take-off load factors (4.5, 2.0)

trade.whirl_margin.label: Whirl-flutter margin: frequency placement or flutter-speed margin
trade.whirl_margin.note: Frequency placement is a proxy for the flutter boundary
trade.whirl_margin.precedent: XV-15 and V-22 use 23 % thick wings to keep whirl flutter beyond dive speed, at a drag and speed cost; a 15 % NASA design lost stiffness, and tailoring recovered stability at about 18 %. Halo's NACA 2423 follows the same precedent.
sources: Acree, Peyran and Johnson, NASA/TP-2004-212262 (thin-wing whirl flutter), as reported

trade.assurance_level.label: Certification basis and design assurance levels
trade.assurance_level.precedent: AW609: applied in 2012, certified as a special-class powered-lift on a basis drawn from Parts 23, 25 and 29 (17,500 lb maximum weight); the criteria took effect on 2 December 2024. A tiltrotor's certification basis is itself a long-lead risk.

trade.structure_joining.label: Primary structure manufacturing and joining: integrated composite, bonded or fastened, machined metal
trade.structure_joining.note: Part and fastener count is weight

trade.hv_installation_standard.label: HV installation standard: insulation, connectors, shielding and segregation
trade.hv_installation_standard.note: Partial discharge at altitude and EMI

trade.integration_rig.label: Integration rig before first flight: HV powertrain and conversion on an iron bird
trade.integration_rig.note: Buys schedule certainty at the cost of a rig
trade.integration_rig.precedent: X-57's integration problems (interference between inverters and onboard systems, a battery redesign) and late component shortages ended the programme before first flight.
sources: NASA: X-57 project creates paths toward electric aviation

trade.envelope_expansion.label: Envelope expansion: build-up flight test or model-based clearance of the conversion corridor
trade.envelope_expansion.note: The computed corridor is edgewise-limited above 45 deg

trade.means_of_compliance.label: Means of compliance: test or analysis credit for whirl flutter and failure cases
trade.means_of_compliance.precedent: AW609 needed new criteria for the transition between modes; its special-class basis took effect in December 2024, twelve years after application.

trade.maintenance_concept.label: Maintenance concept: on-condition or scheduled for tilt mechanism, gearboxes and packs
trade.maintenance_concept.note: Access and removal paths are set in design
trade.maintenance_concept.precedent: V-280 fixed its engines partly so that engine, drive shaft and gearbox can be removed independently, which Bell says cuts maintenance time.
sources: The War Zone: V-280 against V-22, with Bell's head of tiltrotor systems
